ev: RE-JUDGED 2026-08-05 (B-002 closure): the row's own text changed — it now reads «Boot file, authored (always loaded)» — so the prior verdict's text is gone and this restates against the new one.

WHAT THE SCOPE CLAUSE REMOVED: the prior evidence's headline was the host's compiled boot lane at ~16 100 tokens against 500 — 32x. `spec/boot/STATIC.md` is a GENERATED artifact (its own first line: «generated by vibe, do not edit»), and the new sibling anchor ##BUDGETS-GOVERN-AUTHORED-DOCUMENTS-ONLY puts it outside every budget in this table. That 32x is therefore no longer a breach of this row, and the host ruling it mirrors is spec/modules/vibe-workspace/PROP-009-loading-model.md ##ARTIFACTS-CARRY-NO-TOKEN-BUDGET (owner, 2026-07-29).

WHAT THE SCOPE CLAUSE DID NOT REMOVE, and this is why the verdict stays drift: the two AUTHORED boot snippets are over budget on their own. Measured 2026-08-05 with the flow's own conversion (##rule-of-thumb-500-tokens-is-a-page: 500 tokens ~ 375 English words) — `spec/boot/00-core.md` 827 words ~ 1 102 tokens (2.2x) and `spec/boot/90-user.md` 1 282 words ~ 1 709 tokens (3.4x), against 500 each.

The correction the re-judgement buys: the finding was a category error stacked on a real breach. Removing the generated artifact drops the overrun from 32x to 3.4x and moves the addressee from the compiler to the two files a human actually writes — which is the only form of this finding anyone can act on.

PRESCRIBES, judged for coherence and resolving referents. Source 1 — the table it scopes is three rows above it in the same file, and its argument is drawn from that table's own third column: «cut», «collapse», «split» are instructions addressed to a writer, and each row carries one.

Source 2 — the consuming host reached the identical rule independently and by owner ruling, recorded at spec/modules/vibe-workspace/PROP-009-loading-model.md ##ARTIFACTS-CARRY-NO-TOKEN-BUDGET (2026-07-29): «A generated boot artifact carries no token budget… The size budgets of the addressable-specs flow govern authored documents». This is the package catching up to a rule its consumer had already written down, so the confirmation is not the package agreeing with itself.
Referent check: `spec/boot/STATIC.md` exists and declares itself generated on line 1, so the class the clause names is instantiated in the tree rather than hypothetical.
PRESCRIBES, and it is the operative half of its predecessor — the corollary a reader needs in order to act. Source 1: it follows from ##BUDGETS-GOVERN-AUTHORED-DOCUMENTS-ONLY directly above it.

Source 2: PROP-009 ##ARTIFACTS-CARRY-NO-TOKEN-BUDGET states the same corollary in the consumer and names the decision it unblocked — «Compiling a document into the lane is therefore a legitimate answer to a dangling pointer, and «the lane grew» is not an objection to it» — and it names the same residual cost this clause names, the session's context.

Measured instance 2026-08-05: `spec/boot/STATIC.md` stands at 12 088 words (~16 100 tokens) and is under no finding by this table, while the two authored snippets beside it are — which is the clause doing exactly the sorting it claims to do.
